task: FORECASTBUNDLE RESEARCH GOVERNANCE DECISION RECORD D1/D2

D1.name: lower/upper Semantics
D1.designation: ForecastBundle.lower and ForecastBundle.upper are designated as forecast-uncertainty bound fields surrounding point forecast.
D1.limitations: Does not claim 80%, 90%, 95% coverage, confidence intervals, or physical operating limits.

D2.name: Point-Only Representation
D2.designation: Point-only sources may be represented using lower = point, point = point, upper = point.
D2.interpretation: lower = point = upper means no uncertainty information is represented by this point-only source; does NOT mean real-world uncertainty is zero.

scientific_claim_limitations: Establishes contract boundary semantics only. Does not establish uncertainty calibration, coverage, reliability, or empirical accuracy guarantees.

d1_d2_frozen_contract_assessment.reasoning: Degenerate bounds (lower = point = upper) satisfy lower <= point <= upper structural schema constraint without error or schema modification.

engineering_consequence_assessment: Future forecast providers/adapters must format arrays consistently with D1/D2.
Adapters representing point-only models must not fabricate coverage metadata.
Downstream MILP and Rule-Based optimizers continue consuming .point arrays directly.
